title: Cut 65% of Your Tokens With One Claude Code Skill
description:
caveman is a Claude Code skill that makes your agent answer like a caveman: short fragments, full technical accuracy, ~65% fewer output tokens on average (measured on the Claude API).
Pick your grunt level (lite, full, ultra, even wenyan classical Chinese), keep your own language, and let it rewrite your memory files so every session starts smaller.
Faster, cheaper, more readable answers from the same brain.

Link: https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman

#Shorts #ClaudeCode #AI #DevTools #LLM
